input:
Task: audit the Python standard library documentation. HARD CONSTRAINTS: use ONLY the webfetch tool for all HTTP (no bash/curl, no other fetch helpers).
1. webfetch https://docs.python.org/3/library/index.html and select {fetch_count} individual module pages linked from it.
2. webfetch EACH selected page individually; extract per page: title, the first function or class listed, and the approximate number of code examples.
3. If a fetch truncates (stub/empty body) or errors: retry the SAME URL once; if it fails again record it as a gap and move on. Do not stall. Finish with an honest summary: fetched / truncated / failed.
scenario: Published SAI normal 30-page crawl with truncation and same-URL retry.
